MANE_Select.description: Whether GENCODE tags the transcript this protein is translated from as MANE Select: the single transcript per protein-coding gene that Ensembl and RefSeq agree on as the representative isoform.

protein_id.description: Ensembl protein ID including its version suffix, for example ENSP00000493376.2. The _key of this record is the same ID with the version removed.

version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

uniprot_collection.description: Which section of UniProtKB the mapped entries come from: Swiss-Prot for manually reviewed entries, TrEMBL for automatically annotated ones. Swiss-Prot wins when a protein maps into both.

uniprot_ids.description: UniProtKB accessions mapped to this Ensembl protein, which may carry an isoform suffix such as Q6UWL6-5. Usually a single accession; mouse proteins sometimes map to several.

uniprot_names.description: UniProtKB entry names of the mapped accessions, for example CDK2_HUMAN.

dbxrefs.description: Cross-references to other databases, taken from the mapped UniProtKB entries, deduplicated across them and sorted by database name.

name.description: Database the cross-reference points to, for example Ensembl, RefSeq, or PDB.

id.description: Identifier of this protein in that database.

uniprot_full_names.description: Recommended full protein names from the mapped UniProtKB entries, falling back to the submitted name where no recommended name exists.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, uniprot_names, uniprot_full_names, uniprot_ids, MANE_Select, organism, source, source_url, dbxrefs
